name: Protected Geomancer (Geomancer Archetype)
body:
Some geomancers eschew some of their magical capacity to gain the direct aid of a powerful spirit.

These protected geomancers can call upon a spirit that embodies the spirit to which they commune.

Diminished Spellcasting

A protected geomancer gains spells per day and spells prepared using the spell progression tables of an unchained summoner. They use the spells known table to determine their spells prepared each day. They also add any spell that only affects eidolons from the unchained summoner’s spell list to the spells they are available to prepare. This ability modifies spells.

The following abilities replace rebuke spirits.

Guardian Spirit

At 1st level, a protected geomancer can call upon a guardian spirit based upon the spirit to which they commune. This ability acts as the eidolon ability of an unchained summoner except the eidolon subtype changes based on the spirit they have communed with as notated on the following page. The evolutions and base form of the eidolon do not change when the subtype changes, even if they are prohibited for the subtype chosen.

Earth–elemental (earth) or kami
Fire–elemental (fire) or kami
Metal–inevitable or kami
Water–elemental (water) or kami
Wood–kami
Life Link (Su)

At 1st level, a protected geomancer forms a close bond with their eidolon. Whenever the eidolon takes enough damage to send it back to its home plane, as a reaction to the damage, the protected geomancer can sacrifice any number of hit points they have without using an action. Each hit point sacrificed in this way prevents 1 point of damage dealt to the eidolon. This can prevent the eidolon from being sent back to its home plane.

In addition, the eidolon and the protected geomancer must remain within 100 feet of one another for the eidolon to remain at full strength. If the eidolon is beyond 100 feet but closer than 1,000 feet, its current and maximum hit point totals are reduced by 50%. If the eidolon is more than 1,000 feet away but closer than 10,000 feet, its current and maximum hit point totals are reduced by 75%. If the eidolon is more than 10,000 feet away, it is immediately returned to its home plane. Current hit points lost in this way are not restored when the eidolon gets closer to its protected geomancer, but its maximum hit point total does climb to the levels indicated and eventually returns to normal.

Bond Senses (Su)

At 2nd level, a protected geomancer can, as a standard action, share the senses of their eidolon, hearing, seeing, smelling, tasting, and touching everything the eidolon does. They can use this ability a number of rounds per day equal to their geomancer level. There is no maximum range to this effect, but the eidolon and the protected geomancer must be on the same plane. The protected geomancer can end this effect as a free action.

Maker’s Call (Su)

At 6th level, as a standard action, a protected geomancer can call their eidolon to their side.

This functions as dimension door, using the protected geomancer’s caster level. When this ability is used, the eidolon appears adjacent to the protected geomancer (or as close as possible if all adjacent spaces are occupied). If the eidolon is out of range, the ability is wasted. A protected geomancer can use this ability once per day at 6th level, plus one additional time per day for every four levels beyond 6th.

Life Bond (Su)

At 14th level, a protected geomancer’s life becomes linked to their eidolon’s. As long as the eidolon has 1 or more hit points, the protected geomancer is protected from harm. Damage in excess of that which would reduce the protected geomancer to 0 hit points is instead transferred to the eidolon. This damage is transferred 1 point at a time, meaning that as soon as the eidolon is reduced to a number of negative hit points equal to its Constitution score, all excess damage remains with a protected geomancer. Effects that cause death but don’t deal damage are unaffected by this ability. This ability does not affect spells such as baleful polymorph, flesh to stone, imprisonment, or other spells that don’t deal damage.

Breath of Life: The Geomancer, © 2026, Orphaned Bookworm Productions, LLC; Authors: Connor Bates, Norman Mitchell Jr., and Paulo César Viola Da Silva Maia.
